card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS medical words
card.fires_on: Partway through long words written in all capitals, usually in label warnings and section headings, such as RETENTION, MEDICAL, ADVERSE or AIRWAY.

modes.label: Capitalised warning text
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps word in a boxed warning or precaution sentence.

modes.label: Capitalised section cross-references
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps heading name inside a cross-reference or heading.

card.writes: It favours continuing with an upper-case word piece such as W or TI, and suppresses other upper-case starts like OC or O.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long words typed in all capitals, as in label warnings and headings.
